description: [forged] Offline format validator for a UAE Emirates ID number (784-YYYY-NNNNNNN-C, 15 digits). Strips spaces/dashes, checks total length, verifies the 784 prefix, checks the YYYY segment is a plausible birth year (1900-current year), and returns the normalized/formatted number. The final check digit's official algorithm is not publicly documented by the ICP, so it is only extracted, never cryptographically verified. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))
